sources.title: Step-by-Step Perceptron for AND Gate - Scribd
sources.snippet: The document describes a step-by-step example of using a perceptron to solve the AND gate problem. Random initial weights of 0.9 are assigned. The perceptron is trained over multiple rounds using a learning rate of 0.5 to update the weights based on errors. After 2 rounds, the perceptron correctly classifies all inputs to the AND gate.
